description: This file defines a React functional component named PackageEntry, used to display and manage information about a package extension within a web application's preferences panel. It includes subcomponents for toggling hosted usage and uninstalling the extension, manages state for extension properties, and interacts with application mutator methods to update package data.

classes.name: UseHosted
classes.description: A React functional component providing a toggle switch for using hosted when local is unavailable.

methods.name: toggleOfflineOnly
methods.description: Toggles the 'offlineOnly' state and updates the extension via application mutator.

methods.name: changeExtensionName
methods.description: Updates the display name of the extension and persists the change.
